Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[None Shall Pass]]: John Cleese as the Black Knight in ''Monty Python and the Holy Grail'' (1975), standing guard with his sword. In the film he blocks King Arthur at a bridge with the words "None shall pass".

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Black_Knight_in_Monty_Python.jpg Black Knight in Monty Python.jpg], English Wikipedia, a screenshot from the film (author: Python (Monty) Pictures). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026175821/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Black_Knight_in_Monty_Python.jpg Internet Archive], 26 October 2026; image file preserved at [https://web.archive.org/web/20260901171637/https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/1/15/Black_Knight_in_Monty_Python.jpg Internet Archive], 1 September 2026 (SHA-256 ccdf4de028978eee23d84a8ce0f4a57a538eb611f61a8bcdaac30f0a701e6cfb, the same as this file).
